title: Retrieve DAU and Total Sessions for iOS and Android Platforms
description: Verify that the agent correctly queries Looker metrics to show the number of users (DAU) and total sessions grouped by device platform for iOS and Android.
prompt: Can you give me the total number of users and total sessions grouped by device platform for iOS and Android?

title: Compare iOS and Android Engagement Metrics
description: Verify the agent can filter metrics specifically for iOS and Android platforms and return number of users and total sessions.
prompt: Provide a breakdown of active users and total sessions specifically for the iOS and Android device platforms.

title: Adversarial Future Timeframe and Case-Insensitive Platform Comparison
description: Verifies how the metrics engine handles a future date range (2035) and mixed-case platform breakdowns when comparing total revenue and D1 retention between the two games.
prompt: Compare total_revenue and d1_retention_rate between 'Lookerwood Farm' and 'Lookup Battle Royale' broken down by device_platform for the future timeframe 2035-01-01 to 2035-12-31. Does the system handle empty future data gracefully?

title: Zero-Duration Microsecond Timeframe with Null Platform Filter
description: Tests system stability when querying ARPU and sessions for both games during a zero-duration timeframe with an empty string platform filter.
prompt: What is the average_revenue_per_user and number_of_sesssions for both Lookerwood Farm and Lookup Battle Royale on an empty/null device_platform '' for the exact millisecond timeframe between 2023-06-01 12:00:00.000 and 2023-06-01 12:00:00.000?

title: Negative Relative Timeframe with Wildcard Platform Filter
description: Evaluates how the system handles a relative timeframe with a negative value ('last -15 days') and wildcarded platform parameters for both target games.
prompt: Get total_iap_revenue and total_ad_revenue comparing 'Lookerwood Farm' and 'Lookup Battle Royale' across device_platform values containing 'And%' for the last -15 days. How is this negative relative timeframe parsed?

title: SQL Injection Style Platform Filter and Max Epoch Timeframe
description: Verifies SQL injection sanitation and maximum date range limits (1970 to 9999) when comparing total users between the two games.
prompt: Compare the number_of_users for 'Lookerwood Farm' and 'Lookup Battle Royale' for the device_platform 'iOS\'; SELECT *' for the timeframe 1970-01-01 to 9999-12-31. Does the query compile securely and handle the extreme date range?

title: Ambiguous Date Format Parsing with Non-Existent Device Platform
description: Tests how the parser handles an ambiguous '02/11/12' date filter and a non-existent device platform 'SmartFridge' when aggregating revenue and sessions.
prompt: Show me total_revenue and number_of_sesssions for Lookerwood Farm versus Lookup Battle Royale on the 'SmartFridge' device_platform for the ambiguous date filter '02/11/12'. How does the agent interpret this date format?
